title: MV [ MV ] Dungeon crawler minimap plugins?

posts.author: Whoopeecap
posts.body:
Hi!
New here
I'm working on a dungeon crawler strongly inspired by the Persona series of games, but I'm having trouble implementing a minimap system for the dungeons. I'm not really one for programming, like as in, I can't write a single line of code...I know I should learn but I'm holding out hope someone's figured this one out already before I do
(...leaving the inevitable for when I have to do the battle system LMAO)
I'm looking for pre-existing plugins, as I'm not currently in a position to commission anyone for anything. As such, close matches are fine (something that is missing some feature I need but generally matches my idea)
What I'd essentially need is a minimap that shows a grid of, let's say 7x7 tiles around the player, with an ability to indicate the following:
-Walls (preferably this is dark space with outlines, but I'm not picky, anything identifiable as "wall" that isn't strictly medieval-looking in theme will do)
-Paths you have not walked on (preferably this is some muted color)
-Paths you have walked on (preferably this is a bright color that demands attention)
-Player position and direction (the player could be indicated by an arrow, for example)
-Stairs
-Doors (and rooms, but being able to see the door is enough)
-Types of room (healing, save point, shop, other types, no symbol for normal rooms) (this can be shown always or after you've used the room once)
-Exit icon
It should also follow the player and be openable into a full map that shows the entire area with a fog of war effect where you can only see parts you've already seen on the minimap.
Features I'd like for it to have but that aren't necessary:
-Indicators for actors, including moving ones (useful for on map enemies in particular) (bonus points if I can give each actor some property that changes what type of icon they have so I can indicate item boxes vs NPCs vs enemies)
-Indicators for pitfalls, were I to implement any (which I probably don't so if it's not a thing no sweat)
-An ability to choose whether the minimap always points north or turns with the player's direction
-More icons if I need them (custom icons?) such as an elevator icon
I'm willing to compromise on my vision here as I said because I'm totally at the mercy of the innovations of the RPG Maker MV community, but basically Google sucks and all the minimaps I find while super impressive are just really not what this type of game needs.
Attached are a couple of (nearly identical) examples from the Persona series, as well as examples of icons:
Thanks for your time o7
-Veegs

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
there are some minimap plugins, even some of that can be evented out.
but I didn't saw any of the look of  your sample.
as a icon sample should be made probably.
Eliaquim has a minimap plugin (picture or tiles based with icons on it) (MV is free)
UnproPro uses region to paint the minimap (no icons I believe)
Pheonix Kage Desu has a Mini Map with icons available.
KoTC probably too.
but while each works differently, it's hard to know if any of those works.
keep in mind those are a few (unlinked) out of the 10 out there I know off.
some uses 2 images (background and masking) but available with zoom in.
but no icons could be set there.
as it is possible to event it, the exact same layout or similarities require commission
which you don't have access too.
